## Block 1 - Pipeline A: DDC converter
Pipeline A: DDC IFC converter
- Converts .ifc to .xlsx
- Parses the wide table
- Filters out spatial entities (IfcProject, IfcSite, IfcBuilding, IfcBuildingStorey)


Full float precision preserved.

## Block 2 - Pipeline B: IfcOpenShell
Pipeline B: IfcOpenShell Python extraction. 
- Downloads script from GitHub
- Runs ifcopenshell to extract elements, properties, quantities, materials as JSON


Resolves material names (not just IDs).
